title: PHANTOM GRID Automotive L3-L5 Edge Healing & MCP Co-Pilot
full_script: PHANTOM GRID pioneers L3 to L5 edge-native autonomous healing. Subscribing to SOME/IP events, the engine clamps torque within microseconds on thermal overload. All decisions are immutably signed and committed to an embedded SQLite audit database. The in-vehicle MCP server bridges digital twin telemetry to AI Agents via standard JSON-RPC. Integrated with Nostr decentralized mesh, achieving global situational awareness.
